memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The boundary then went up to Debir from the Valley of Achor and turned north to Gilgal, which faces the Pass of Adummim south of the gorge. It continued along to the waters of En Shemesh and came out at En Rogel. Then it ran up the Valley of Ben Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem). From there it climbed to the top of the hill west of the Hinnom Valley at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim - Josh 15:7-8 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The border description now passes right by "the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem)." At this point Jerusalem was still in enemy hands, not yet the great city of David and the temple. But God's Word pauses to name it, quietly pointing ahead to what this place would one day become — the city where God would put His name, where kings would reign, where Jesus Himself would die and rise.

It is striking that God traces His plan through places that, at the time, held no obvious promise. Jerusalem was just a Jebusite stronghold, an unconquered problem on Judah's border. Yet God knew what He would do there. The most significant events in the history of the world would unfold on this ground that seemed, for now, like unfinished business.

This reminds us that God sees the future of places and people that look unremarkable or even troublesome today. The situation in your life that seems like nothing but an obstacle, the unconquered corner you keep worrying over — God may be planning something there you cannot yet imagine. He specialises in taking ground that seems least promising and making it the stage for His glory. What looks like a problem on the border may become, in time, a place where His name is honoured.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What "unconquered corner" of your life feels like nothing but a problem?
- Do you believe God can bring something significant out of unpromising ground?
- How does God's long view of Jerusalem encourage you about your own situation?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You see what unpromising places and situations can become. Help me to trust that even the troublesome corners of my life are within Your redemptive plan. Amen.
